## 更新内容 | What's Changed

### 文件目录收藏 | Directory Bookmarks

- 文件页支持收藏常用目录: 点击路径栏的星标即可收藏当前目录, 也可在详情面板中收藏选中的文件夹; 已收藏的目录再次点击星标会打开编辑, 不会误删. (#10)
  Bookmark frequently used directories in Files: click the star in the path bar to bookmark the open directory, or bookmark a selected folder from the details panel. Clicking the star on a bookmarked directory opens its editor instead of removing it. (#10)

- 工具栏的返回起始目录按钮旁新增收藏夹, 按保存顺序列出收藏目录, 点击即可跳转, 支持方向键, Home 和 End 键导航, 并标出当前目录和起始目录.
  A new Bookmarks button next to Go to start directory lists bookmarks in saved order. Click one to jump there or navigate with the arrow, Home, and End keys; the current and start directories are marked.

- 收藏可标注橙, 青柠, 青, 蓝, 粉五种颜色, 带颜色的收藏在文件列表和详情面板中显示为彩色实心文件夹; 编辑时还可设为起始目录或取消收藏.
  Tag a bookmark with one of five colors (orange, lime, cyan, blue, pink); colored bookmarks appear as filled, colored folders in the file list and details panel. The editor can also set a bookmark as the start directory or remove it.

- 收藏在所有设备间通用, 恢复默认设置不会清除收藏.
  Bookmarks are shared across all devices and are kept when restoring default settings.

- 进入文件页, 切换设备或返回起始目录时, 若起始目录在当前设备上不存在或无权访问, 会改为打开下载目录并给出提示, 已保存的起始目录保持不变.
  When the start directory is missing or inaccessible on the current device, entering Files, switching devices, or going to the start directory now opens the downloads folder with a notice instead. The saved start directory is left unchanged.

### 体验与修复 | Experience and Fixes

- 修复部分设备 (如 vivo) 因修改时间格式不同导致目录无法打开的问题, 文件列表现在兼容 CRLF 换行, 小数秒和 1970 年以前的时间. (#10)
  Fixed folders failing to open on some devices (such as vivo) because of differently formatted modified times. File listings now tolerate CRLF line endings, fractional seconds, and pre-1970 times. (#10)

- 电脑连接手机热点时, 一键切换到 WiFi 也能找到设备 IP, 并优先选择电脑可直接访问的网段. (#10)
  Switching to WiFi now finds the device address when the computer is connected to the phone's own hotspot, preferring an address on a subnet the computer can reach directly. (#10)

- 修复向部分设备推送剪贴板文本时, 文本已写入却提示 "系统拒绝 shell 剪贴板访问" 的问题; 权限提示现在明确指手机端的 ADB shell. (#10)
  Fixed clipboard pushes to some devices reporting that shell clipboard access was denied even though the text was stored. The permission message now makes clear it refers to the phone-side ADB shell. (#10)

- 错误提示 8 秒后自动消失 (成功提示仍为 3 秒), 鼠标悬停或聚焦时保持显示; 文件列表加载失败时不再重复弹出提示. (#10)
  Error toasts now dismiss after 8 seconds (success toasts still after 3) and stay open while hovered or focused. A failed file listing no longer shows a duplicate toast. (#10)

- macOS 应用菜单不再显示 "服务" 菜单项.
  The macOS app menu no longer shows the Services item.
